def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque

    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    components = []

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            grid[ny][nx] == color and (ny, nx) not in seen):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            components.append((color, comp))

    marker = None
    for color, comp in components:
        rs = [p[0] for p in comp]
        cs = [p[1] for p in comp]
        top, bottom, left, right = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
        if len(comp) != (bottom - top + 1) + (right - left + 1) - 1:
            continue
        corners = [(y, x) for y, x in comp
                   if sum(1 for yy, xx in comp if yy == y) > 1
                   and sum(1 for yy, xx in comp if xx == x) > 1]
        if not corners:
            continue
        corner = corners[0]
        # The long arms point from the corner along the vertical and horizontal axes.
        vertical_cells = [y for y, x in comp if x == corner[1]]
        horizontal_cells = [x for y, x in comp if y == corner[0]]
        vr = -1 if min(vertical_cells) < corner[0] else 1
        hc = -1 if min(horizontal_cells) < corner[1] else 1
        marker = (color, corner, vr, -hc)
        break

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if marker is None:
        return out

    color, (r, c), dr, dc = marker
    y, x = r + dr, c + dc
    target = None
    while 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
        if grid[y][x] != bg:
            target = grid[y][x]
            break
        y += dr
        x += dc

    if target is not None:
        for comp_color, comp in components:
            if comp_color == target and (y, x) in comp:
                for yy, xx in comp:
                    out[yy][xx] = color
                break
    return out
